name: forge-engine
description: Idea → validated → designed → built → verified → shipped. A gated, memory-backed product pipeline for coding agents: evidence-checked validation, design system + screenshot critique, stack packs, code & security review, QA coverage, deploy with real checks.

interface.shortDescription: Gated product pipeline: validate, design, build, review, QA and ship — with evidence and memory.
interface.longDescription: forge-engine drives an idea through 14 gated stages. Gates are deterministic code: evidence must be quoted from real sources, designs are screenshotted and critiqued, code is scanned for injection and secrets, every acceptance criterion needs a tagged test, and deploys are smoke-tested on the live URL. The MCP server exposes the pipeline; the skills are the playbooks.
